I am a political science doctoral candidate, studying International Relations at the [University of Texas at Dallas](https://www.utdallas.edu/fact-sheets/epps/phd-political-science/). My research topics are Conflict, Human Rights, and International Law.

- My research focuses on conflict processes and political violence...
- I further focus on the prevention of torture...
- Furthermore, I research international human rights litigation...
